source='''def transform(grid):
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 3 in row]
    cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[rows[0]]) if value == 3]
    r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows)
    c0, c1 = min(cols), max(cols)
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    block = [grid[r][w - 1 - c1:w - c0] for r in range(h - 1 - r1, h - r0)]
    return [list(reversed(row)) for row in reversed(block)]
'''
